content.title: Diner Alert Payoff | Phone Interruption, Coastal Travel and Calm Contrast
content.summary: An adult coastal engineer verifies a south-bay warning from a safe beach chair. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.recommended_input: One clearly adult coastal engineer tastes a pepper roll outside an original yellow roadside diner beside a dark coupe. Match one tire spin to a high road view as the same coupe travels from diner to south-bay beach. A fiery object creates one far-off plume; the engineer smiles and takes one measured drink in the foreground.

invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.

invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The calm final action contrasts with the large background event."
